name: agentlog
description: Makes AI coding agents commit every change locally with clear messages, and shows the history as a clickable timeline with diffs. Nothing is pushed.

enforce_everywhere.title: Enforce in every git repo
enforce_everywhere.description: If on, agentlog enforces commits in every git repo. If off (default), only in repos where you ran /agentlog:init.

ui_port.title: Timeline UI port
ui_port.description: Local port for the agentlog timeline UI
